# Apache HTTPD (HTTP) — root-context-sse

App at /, proxy at /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The config has no WebSocket support at all, and the backend runs VAADIN_PUSH_TRANSPORT=SERVER_SENT_EVENTS with the fallback disabled, so push either rides plain HTTP or fails visibly.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# SSE-only proxy: deliberately no WebSocket support anywhere in this file — no
# upgrade=websocket, no ws:// worker, no RewriteRule on the Upgrade header.
# This is the "proxy that blocks WebSocket" case the SSE transport exists for.
#
# SSE needs nothing special from mod_proxy_http: EventSource is an ordinary GET
# that streams text/event-stream, and the client-to-server messages are XHR
# POSTs to the same path, so the existing rules carry both directions.
# ProxyTimeout is raised once in the shared httpd.conf.

<Location />
    ProxyPass         http://vaadin:8080/
    ProxyPassReverse  http://vaadin:8080/
</Location>
```
